Precisamos de um(a) fornecedor(a) com experiência em criar conteúdos educacionais, sólido conhecimento sobre Bases da IA – conceitos, evolução, tipos e algoritmos aplicáveis. Agro e Transformação Digital – características do agro brasileiro, desafios tecnológicos e iniciativas de inovação. Dados no Campo – fontes (sensores, drones, satélites, sistemas de gestão), tipos de dados, pré-processamento, armazenamento, pipelines de dados e qualidade. Aplicações da IA – pecuária de precisão (monitoramento, saúde, alimentação, produtividade) e integração de tecnologias (drones, IoT, decisões em tempo real). IA Generativa – usos no agro (relatórios, previsões, simulações, assistentes virtuais), modelos disponíveis, ferramentas e limitações. Mercado e Cases – startups, plataformas e resultados alcançados. Ética e Sustentabilidade – uso responsável de dados e automação, impactos ambientais, inclusão digital e desafios regulatórios, clareza na comunicação escrita e capacidade didática.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Análise e Otimização Visual (Imagens): Conferir as imagens presentes no material, verificando sua correção, adequação ao tema, público-alvo e contexto. Propor substituições de imagens, se necessário, indicando opções de bancos de imagens ou imagens autorais com boa resolução. Garantir que as imagens selecionadas ou propostas estejam em alta qualidade e resolvam visualmente as necessidades do texto. Garantia de Qualidade e Alinhamento: Validar as atividades e seus feedbacks para assegurar que simulam casos reais e incentivam a tomada de decisão. Validar materiais complementares, confirmando sua adequação ao público-alvo e sugerindo novos, se pertinente. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. Responsabilizar-se por sinalizar e implementar os ajustes necessários para garantir a integridade e precisão do conteúdo. Conferir e recomendar bibliografia ou material complementar. Capacitação: Realizaremos um momento de alinhamento e capacitação com o validador, para garantir que ele compreenda integralmente as diretrizes pedagógicas, os objetivos do curso e os parâmetros esperados para a atualização. Validação interna da equipe (DI): Após a entrega do conteúdo validado, a DI realizará uma leitura e solicitará os ajustes necessários, assegurando a coerência pedagógica, a aderência aos objetivos de aprendizagem e a qualidade do material produzido. Ajustes e refinamento do conteúdo: Caso sejam identificadas inconsistências ou oportunidades de melhoria, o conteúdo retornará para ajustes por parte da conteudista, seguindo as orientações da DI. Finalização e conclusão da demanda: Com os ajustes finalizados e o conteúdo aprovado internamente, consideraremos a etapa de atualização concluída, encerrando a entrega conforme o escopo previsto no contrato.

PARA PRESTAR ESTE SERVIÇO VOCÊ PRECISA DE:

Expertise nos temas mencionados acima. Desejável experiência em validação de material didático para EaD;

We’re looking for a Program Manager to lead Design Operations end-to-end—from brief to delivery. In this role, you’ll run the operating cadence for a global creative team, own the intake and prioritization process, and coordinate closely with Marketing, Sales, Product, and Design. You’ll bring structure to creative work without stifling it: clear briefs, transparent timelines, measurable KPIs, and smooth handoffs.   • Partner with global stakeholders (primarily U.S.) in Marketing, Growth, Sales, and Product to turn business needs into actionable creative plans and timelines.
  • Establish operating cadences—intake, kickoffs, reviews, approvals, retrospectives—and codify SLAs from brief to handoff.
  • Lead vendor operations: NDAs, onboarding, scopes, content coordination, deliverables tracking, and invoice alignment to budget.
  • Define and track KPIs for design projects (throughput, cycle time, on-time delivery, rework rate, stakeholder satisfaction); publish clear reports.
  • Build internal communication formats and knowledge repositories: weekly updates, quarterly reviews, playbooks, and templates.
  • Support formal planning and optimization: annual and quarterly plans, resource modeling, process-improvement experiments, and post-mortems.
  • Proactively surface risks, remove blockers, and drive crisp, timely communication across time zones.

Requirements

Who You Are

Must-Haves

  • 3+ years in creative operations, PMO, marketing operations, or design program management in a fast-paced environment.
  • Mastery of project management tools (Asana required) and spreadsheets (Excel/Google Sheets); able to build dashboards and status views.
  • Demonstrated success coordinating global stakeholders and vendors; excellent written and verbal communication in English.
  • Strong process design and change-management skills; can zoom from big picture to detail and back.
  • Ownership mindset: proactive, organized, and unafraid to raise flags early and drive decisions.
  • Flexibility to collaborate with U.S.-based teams and join occasional evening calls.

Nice-to-Haves

  • Experience in B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Notion/Confluence, or similar knowledge-management tools.
  • Hands-on exposure to creative/brand/design workflows; know what a good brief and review cycle looks like.

Why Join Us?

At Cyera, we care about collaboration, innovation, and agility. We take “teamwork” seriously—with our inclusive and supportive culture at the forefront—and we’re just as serious about nurturing Cyerans to grow, both personally and professionally.

Feel free to apply even if your experience doesn’t tick every box.

We’re building something special here—and we welcome Cyerans with diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences.

ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a leading consumer finance company dedicated to helping people achieve their goals through responsible lending. Through its fully-digital platform, Happy Money partners with credit unions, banks and asset managers to originate high-quality credit solutions, diversify their portfolios and expand their impact and reach nationwide.

Backed by investors like TruStage Ventures, Happy Money enables financial institutions to grow as a force for good in their communities while helping people use money as a tool for their happiness. Together with their community-focused capital partner network, Happy Money has originated over $6 billion in loans representing more than 300,000 members who have taken greater control of their financial futures. Learn more at happymoney.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Lead Analyst in the Pricing & Conversion team at Happy Money, you will be responsible for developing, analyzing, and optimizing our application conversion and pricing strategy. Sitting within the Risk and Analytics team, you will own analytics and strategy changes, periodic reporting, and initiatives that enhance our funnel conversion and optimize leads.

You will work cross-functionally with Credit Operations, Product, and Engineering to drive proactive, data-driven strategies that support responsible growth for Happy Money and our lending partners.

Conversion:

  • Identify and evaluate new vendors / data sources and create business cases and present them to senior management.
  • Conduct ad-hoc analysis related to risk management, product, and operations.

Pricing:

  • Develop and implement credit strategies leveraging data, machine learning models and advanced analytics tools to mitigate losses and maintain excellent customer experience.
  • Continue to innovate by testing new data, analytical approaches and models.
  • Monitor and analyze portfolio performance at a granular segment level on an ongoing basis. Identify trends and conduct root-cause analysis to isolate key performance drivers.
  • Communicate findings and recommendations to the Risk Management and broader Happy Money community in a clear and concise manner.

ABOUT YOU

  • 5+ years of experience managing credit risk strategies.

  • Strong proficiency with Python & SQL and the ability to analyze large, complex datasets and derive actionable insights.

  • Company-paid short & long term disability and life insurance
  • Monthly tech stipend to help cover expenses for remote work

JOB TITLE Product Lead, Slate

JOB DESCRIPTION SUMMARY

The Product Lead, Slate, is responsible for the strategic oversight and continuous improvement of the Slate CRM platform, supporting functions such as admissions, enrollment, communications, and student engagement. This role will report to the Director, Enterprise Cloud Systems. The role leads the full product lifecycle—from ideation and development to deployment and optimization—to ensure the platform aligns with institutional goals and delivers measurable value. In this capacity, the Product Lead may manage a team, including direct reports such as system administrators or analysts who support Slate. They provide leadership, coaching, and performance management to ensure the team delivers secure, scalable, and user-centered solutions. The Product Lead works closely with these team members to align technical execution with product strategy and ensure seamless delivery of enhancements and support. The role requires close collaboration with stakeholders across business and technology domains to define and communicate a clear product vision. The Product Lead plays a key role in shaping the end-to-end user experience and ensuring that Slate evolves to meet the institution’s changing needs.

JOB DESCRIPTION

Responsibilities:

  • Serve as the Product Lead for Slate, managing tenant configuration, security administration, and release planning.
  • Provide technical support and troubleshoot issues related to Slate and other enterprise cloud systems as needed.
  • Collaborate closely with the Graduate Studies team—including Recruiting & Marketing and Admissions—Summer Studies, and University Marketing to ensure system functionality aligns with strategic goals and operational needs.
  • Define and manage the Slate product roadmap, ensuring alignment with institutional goals and user needs.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality solutions, monitor performance, and manage transitions from development to production.
  • Serve as a liaison between business units and technical teams, translating requirements and resolving integration or customization challenges.
  • Coordinate with enterprise architects and data teams to ensure alignment of product and platform strategies.
  • Evaluate and prototype new Slate features and technologies to support innovation and continuous improvement.
  • Lead major system releases, ensuring new functionality meets business and technical requirements.
  • Mentor team members who support Slate operations and development.
  • Ensure the team maintains system performance, security, and compliance standards.
  • Align team activities with product goals, ensuring operational readiness for new features and updates.
  • Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, information systems or related field.

  • Proven ability to engage and influence senior stakeholders in support of strategic initiatives.
  • Experience managing technical teams or direct reports is strongly preferred.
  • Familiarity with CRM platforms (preferably Slate), design thinking principles, and modern software delivery methodologies.
  • Strong communication, time management, and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Possess a very high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Self‑directed, highly motivated and proactive
  • Highly organized and process‑driven
  • Excellent problem‑solving, critical thinking and analytical skills

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools. A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments. The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code, but is also passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will design, implement and manage our growing corporate cloud-first infrastructure and networks. You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment. You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR. The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise. This role will report to the Director of IT.

About The Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees via Slack, Jira, etc. We're all Mac. You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees. You'll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You'll support and manage SaaS applications – Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc. You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools – MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc. You'll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.) You'll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork. Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion. You're comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them. You'll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you're experienced with agile methods and sprints). You'll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring To Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilize open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • You are able to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You've provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you're familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.

  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • You take security seriously, and you know what PGP is.
  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • You must be able to competently and demonstrably know the troubleshooting steps and layers of the OSI model — you know how to methodically troubleshoot problems without wasting someone's time.
  • You can self-manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams. Strong organisational and task-management skills are critical.
  • You're comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice To Haves

Culture Fit

A Unidas, integrante do grupo Brookfield, é uma das maiores empresas do setor de mobilidade no Brasil.

Conta com cerca de 100 mil ativos entre veículos leves, caminhões, máquinas e equipamentos pesados, e oferece uma plataforma completa de soluções de gestão e locação de veículos, operações e manutenção, trazendo economia e praticidade para pessoas e empresas em todo o país.

E tem mais! Na Unidas você ainda conta com:

  • Ambiente que valoriza a diversidade e inclusão.
  • Desafios reais com impacto direto nos negócios.

A Unidas integra o portfólio da Brookfield Asset Management, uma das maiores gestoras de ativos do mundo, com visão de longo prazo e compromisso com o desenvolvimento sustentável.

ICON plc is a world‑leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team.   • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.
  • Staying informed on evolving regulatory guidelines and industry best practices to continually enhance the pharmacovigilance processes within the organization.

Your Profile:

  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.

Our vision

Everyone who wants a family should have the chance to try. For the 1 in 6 families that struggle to conceive, fertility treatments are an option but they are expensive. We created the world’s first IVF insurance allowing more people who wish to be parents to pursue treatment with increased financial flexibility. You’ll be the first human touchpoint for patients early in their fertility journey; answering questions, building trust, and making sure they feel supported every step of the way.

This is a unique opportunity to support people at one of the most pivotal moments in their lives and help shape how Gaia shows up for them.

  • You’ll work closely with our Marketing team to manage the prospect pipeline for any patient starting their fertility journey in the early stages.

  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)

  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:

Parsons is seeking a Senior Compensation Manager, Incentive Compensation to take end-to-end ownership of our cash incentive programs, stock incentive plans, and overall equity administration—including the Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP). The role offers a mix of recurring responsibilities and initiative-driven projects.

As part of a high-performing team of human resources professionals, you will lead through influence, collaboration, and expertise. Reporting to the Director of Compensation, this role is fully remote/virtual.

Key Responsibilities

  • Incentive Program Ownership

    • Actively lead and mentor a team of two compensation professionals.
    • Collaborate cross-functionally to drive alignment, consistency, and excellence in program delivery.

  • Communication & Reporting

  • Additional Contributions
    • Serve as a key contributor to Parsons’ Proxy Compensation & Discussion Analysis compensation and pay versus performance tables, and various Committee / Board materials.
    • Respond to and manage audit requests from internal and external stakeholders, ensuring proper delegation within the Compensation Team.
    • Lead or provide consultation on incentive compensation-related project initiatives.

Qualifications & Skills

  • Education
    • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Human Resources, or a related field.
  • Experience
    • 10+ years of related experience in incentive compensation, including some experience managing a team.
    • Industry experience in defense, intelligence, or critical infrastructure is preferred.
  • Technical & Analytical Skills
    • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to understand broader concepts and communicate persuasively with HR and business leaders.
    • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
    • Preferred experience with Workday.
  • Interpersonal & Leadership Skills
    • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging to different audiences.
    • Proven ability to build and leverage relationships across an organization.
    • Strong professionalism, personal accountability, and resilience, with the ability to work effectively under pressure in a demanding environment.
    • Demonstrated integrity, objectivity, and the ability to influence at all organizational levels.
  • Certifications
    • Certified Compensation Professional (CCP) designation preferred, or progress toward CCP certification.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high‑velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you.

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

Responsabilidades principais

  • Anotar e preparar datasets de visão computacional.
  • Projetar, treinar, validar e otimizar modelos de deep learning para classificação, detecção e segmentação de imagens.
  • Treinar e implementar modelos YOLO (You Only Look Once) para tarefas de detecção de objetos.
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de inferência para execução eficiente em produção.
  • Implementar práticas de MLOps: CI/CD de modelos, versionamento de dados e experimentos, monitoramento e re-treino automático.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com engenheiros de software para integrar os modelos em sistemas e aplicações.

Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Conhecimento de Python em quaisquer das bibliotecas de ML/DL (PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV).
  • Experiência prática com YOLO (treinamento e inferência em problemas de detecção de objetos).
  • Experiência sólida em visão computacional (classificação, detecção, segmentação).
  • Experiência em MLOps com quaisquer das ferramentas: AWS SageMaker Studio, MLflow, Kubeflow, Docker, Kubernetes, Airflow.
  • Conhecimento em boas práticas de engenharia de software (Git, testes automatizados, ambientes reprodutíveis).

Diferenciais

  • Experiência em dados estruturados: preparação de dataset, treinamento e inferência em problemas de regressão (ex.: regressão linear, regressão logística, árvores de decisão) e classificação tabular.
  • Análise exploratória de dados estruturados (ex.: Análise das componentes principais - PCA, análise de correlação, clustering com K-Means).
  • Otimização de modelos para edge devices (TensorRT, ONNX, quantização).
  • Contribuições para projetos open source ou publicações técnicas.

Métricas e gráficos que deve saber interpretar

Visão computacional (foco principal):

  • Curvas Precision-Recall (PR) e AP por classe.
  • Curva ROC e AUC.
  • Matriz de confusão.
  • Curvas de perda e acurácia durante o treinamento.
  • Distribuição de IoU (Interseção Sobre a União).
  • Learning curves (treino vs. validação).

Dados estruturados (como diferencial):

  • Gráficos de resíduos em regressão.
  • Curvas de calibração de probabilidade.
  • Feature importance, SHAP e PDP/ICE plots.
  • Heatmaps de correlação e PCA (scree plot, biplot).

MLOps / produção:

  • Gráficos de detecção de drift de dados.
  • Distribuição de probabilidades de saída (overconfidence).
  • Métricas de latência/throughput.
  • Consumo de GPU/CPU/memória em inferência.

description:
Staff Engineer - Feegow (100% remote in Brazil)

Company Description

You might have heard about us but with a different name: Feegow, Doctoralia, or Docplanner. The names differ depending on the country, but we are all part of the Docplanner Group.

It all started over 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today the next step is to help people live longer and healthier lives.

In 2022 Feegow joined the Docplanner Group, a health‑tech company. We are dedicated to developing innovative solutions and promoting access to top‑tier management for physicians seeking to take their practices to the next level, as well as managers in search of a robust solution that covers end‑to‑end operations. Our ultimate goal is to create a world where everyone can access high‑quality healthcare.

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 50 million patients trust us every month. 300,000+ specialists believe in us and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2,500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup‑mindset we started with over 12 years ago.

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that considering the diversity of human experience makes a better healthcare experience for all. We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we’re 100% remote‑friendly.

Hybrid model (RJ): If you live in RJ and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in Santo Cristo/RJ and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

Hybrid model (CWB): If you live in Curitiba and the metropolitan region, you will work a few days in our office in the center of Curitiba and from home (to be aligned with your leadership).

Remote model: you will work 100% from home, but you will also be welcome in our offices in Curitiba and Rio de Janeiro.

Job Description

We are looking for a passionate and experienced Staff Engineer to co‑lead our modernization efforts, drive innovation, and play a key role in our product evolution. Your expertise in cloud technologies, legacy system migrations, and microservices will help modernize our architecture and enhance scalability, ensuring the continued growth of Feegow and Docplanner Group.

Role

As a Staff Engineer in this area, you’ll be fully responsible and accountable for leading impactful and complex cross‑group and cross‑area technical initiatives, ensuring high‑quality solutions with high operational standards. You’ll also actively partner with Engineering Managers and other tech counterparts to shape the direction of our area and the company as a whole. The role reports directly to the Engineering Director.

We are committed to continuous improvement, open feedback, and working efficiently towards our goals. This role provides an opportunity to actively contribute to the technical direction of the area.

Our tech stack

Docplanner Tech includes .Net, PHP, and Vue/React, running on Kubernetes in AWS. While expertise in these technologies isn’t required, this is a very technical and hands‑on role, for which strong communication skills and experience influencing technical decisions are also essential to effectively support the teams.

What you will be doing

  • Lead and drive technical initiatives that impact area level directions (~5 teams).
  • Actively partner with your Engineering Manager / Tech lead counterparts and engineering teams, as well as working closely with the leaders of the area/company to develop an effective technical strategy.
  • Provide accountability for all the technical initiatives led.
  • Act as a point of reference for our Engineering teams.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentorship, and coaching inside the team.

Qualifications

  • Solid technical background related to the whole SDLC principles and practices (Agile/CD, Lean, SRE, DevOps) and can support and unblock engineering teams in complex technical discussions.
  • Legacy software modernization and migration: proven experience in modernizing and migrating legacy systems to modern architectures.
  • Approach software development with a lean, proactive, and positive mindset, balancing impact and long‑term sustainable development, with a strong accountability for delivering high‑quality solutions.
  • Strong experience in backend development with a holistic understanding of full‑stack systems.
  • Experience in cross‑team initiative and creating buy‑in for technical initiatives.
  • Believe in continuous learning and improvement.
  • Experience not only designing/implementing/delivering high‑quality and impactful solutions, but also guiding and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Additional Relevant

  • Domain‑Driven Design.
  • Expertise in AWS to help shaping our cloud infrastructure.
  • Ability to oversee database optimizations (MySQL) for scalable solutions.
  • Cloud‑native architectures using microservices and serverless along with interaction styles, as synchronous and asynchronous communication, data streaming, and API technologies and lifecycle management.
  • Advanced English skills: comfortable communicating in written and verbal English across global teams.
  • Previous experience in consulting is a plus.

Important

Docplanner is an international English‑first company. Therefore, please be sure to send your CV in English.

Benefits

  • Compensatory time off (Banco de Horas);

title: Litigation & Regulatory Counsel, Brazil
description:
Discord is used by over 200 million people every month for many different reasons, but there’s one thing that nearly everyone does on our platform: play video games. Over 90% of our users play games, spending a combined 1.5 billion hours playing thousands of unique titles on Discord each month. Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We are focused on making it easier and more fun for people to talk and hang out before, during, and after playing games.

We’re looking for an experienced Counsel located in Brazil to join our Litigation and Regulatory Legal team. You’ll use your experience handling a variety of litigation matters, process building, and taking a hands‑on approach to advance Discord’s interests in Brazil. From engagement with legal and regulatory bodies working cross‑functionally with our public policy lead for Brazil, to pre‑litigation disputes to complex and business‑critical litigation matters and engagement with law enforcement, you’ll develop processes for handling issues in Brazil and represent the company in legal and law‑enforcement matters. You’ll play a critical role on Discord’s Legal team and collaborate with colleagues throughout the company as you successfully advocate for Discord.

What you’ll be doing

  • Defend Discord in litigation and regulatory/investigatory matters in Brazil
  • Draft responses to official queries from law enforcement, regulators, and other governmental entities
  • Assess judicial landscape and monitor court decisions to determine impacts on Discord’s legal positions and advise Discord accordingly
  • Collaborate with regional public policy member on regulatory and legal engagement strategy
  • Advise on what Discord’s approach should be with respect to consumer complaint agencies and other similar governmental agencies (e.g. PROCON)
  • Outside counsel management: negotiate best in class engagements and fee agreements with Brazilian outside counsel
  • Engage with and educate Brazilian law enforcement and other governmental entities as needed on topics including Discord’s policies and practices regarding user data requests, child safety, and content moderation
  • Serve as a point of contact for law enforcement and regulatory questions and escalations
  • Build regional escalation and matter tracking processes
  • Counsel Legal and cross‑functional colleagues on Brazilian law applicable to platform liability, user data disclosure, content moderation, minor safety, data privacy and related topics.

What you should have

  • Bachelor of Laws degree or Juris Doctor degree from a respected law school and license to practice law in Brazil
  • 7+ years PQE combined experience at a well‑respected law firm and in‑house legal department for a consumer‑facing technology platform
  • Experience with regulatory investigations
  • Demonstrated subject matter expertise in Internet law, including for example: platform liability, minor safety, privacy, consumer protection, and other relevant areas of law for a consumer‑facing technology platform
  • Strategic mindset that balances proactive action and pragmatic risk management within resource constraints
  • Excellent writer and communicator who can tailor the message to the audience
  • Willingness to take on any project, from large to small
  • Experience with scaling processes and procedures for a fast‑growing company
  • Demonstrated experience managing projects, prioritizing, and consistently achieving results
  • Curiosity and ability to jump into less familiar areas and learn while doing
  • High emotional intelligence with an attitude of open‑mindedness, collaboration, flexibility, growth‑mindset, kindness, and being open and humble
  • Relevant experience in Latin American countries outside of Brazil

This is an international position in Brazil employed by an international PEO. #LI-Remote

Why Discord?

Discord plays a uniquely important role in the future of gaming. We’re a multiplatform, multigenerational and multiplayer platform that helps people deepen their friendships around games and shared interests. We believe games give us a way to have fun with our favorite people, whether listening to music together or grinding in competitive matches for diamond rank. Join us in our mission! Your future is just a click away!

Discord is committed to inclusion and providing reasonable accommodations during the interview process. We want you to feel set up for success, so if you are in need of reasonable accommodations, please let your recruiter know.

title: Gerente de Conservação – Agricultura e Pecuária Regenerativas no Cerrado
description:
Gerente de Conservação – Agricultura e Pecuária Regenerativas no Cerrado

O que buscamos em você

Você está buscando uma carreira para ajudar pessoas e a natureza? Guiada pela ciência, a TNC cria soluções inovadoras e práticas para os maiores desafios do mundo, de forma que pessoas e natureza possam prosperar juntas. Estamos em busca de alguém apaixonado pelo Cerrado e motivado por fazer parte de uma transformação na cadeia da agricultura e da pecuária, com perfil solucionador de problemas e com habilidade de criar e fortalecer relações. Uma pessoa energizada, dinâmica, com iniciativa, habilidades interpessoais sólidas e alta capacidade de trabalho em equipe. Esperamos que você traga sua ampla experiência na gestão de portfólio e equipes e no trabalho colaborativo, para garantir a implementação e continuidade eficiente e efetiva de projetos e iniciativas da TNC Brasil. Junte-se a nós!

Descrição da posição

Na posição de Gerente de Conservação – Agricultura e Pecuária Regenerativas no Cerrado, você será responsável por liderar e gerenciar um portfólio diversificado de iniciativas de conservação, governança, desenvolvimento sustentável ligados à agenda de agricultura e pecuária no Cerrado, visando fomentar uma transição para sistemas regenerativos. Você lidera uma equipe que lida com problemas sistêmicos e complexos relacionados à expansão das cadeias produtivas, uso e ocupação do solo, mecanismos financeiros para financiamento da agricultura e pecuária sustentável e governança territorial. Deverá conectar a proteção da biodiversidade, evidências baseadas em ciências, relação com comunidades locais e parceiros locais/regionais à implementação dos projetos de Agricultura Regenerativa. Servirá como ponto focal de projetos a parceiros chave do setor privado, outras organizações de conservação, fundações e comunidade acadêmica. Esta posição reportará para o/a Diretor/a de Conservação para o Cerrado.

A atuação da TNC busca sempre alcançar resultados mensuráveis e de impacto, considerando não apenas a avaliação de projetos implementados pela TNC mas também do ganho de escala através de arranjos de governança e parcerias fomentadas ou fortalecidas. Garantiremos que as parcerias estratégicas foram estabelecidas, que atores chave tem capacidade para execução e que existem metas claras de curto prazo a serem perseguidas. Garantiremos o avanço contínuo dos projetos a partir de uma gestão ágil, organizada e transparente.

Essa vaga é home-office, por isso características como auto-gestão e auto-motivação são importantes. Profissionais de qualquer região do Brasil são elegíveis, no entanto, será dada prioridade para profissionais que residam no Cerrado, especialmente nos estados de Mato Grosso, Goiás ou Tocantins.

Responsabilidades e Escopo de trabalho:

  • Segue e promove ativamente nosso Código de Conduta tanto internamente quanto externamente, demonstrando de forma contínua e consistente alinhamento com nossos valores.
  • Lidera uma equipe e um portfólio de projetos relacionados à agricultura e pecuária no Cerrado Brasileiro, considerando interlocução com equipes no Brasil, América Latina e na equipe global. Serão necessárias habilidades de liderança sem relações diretas de supervisão.
  • Supervisionar equipe técnica localizada em diferentes regiões, com responsabilidade pela gestão de desempenho, formação e desenvolvimento dos profissionais supervisionados.
  • Liderar processos de monitoramento, avaliação e reporte de resultados (Trimestrais, Anuais, reportes a doadores etc.), analisando avanços e barreiras junto a stakeholders internos/externos.
  • Estabelece e mantém padrões ótimos de desempenho dentro do orçamento.
  • Redige solicitações de proposta (RFPs) para obtenção de financiamento por meio de subsídios/contratos para o programa, gere a execução técnica/financeiro dos projetos sob sua responsabilidade e gerencia o relacionamento técnico com doadores e financiadores.
  • Toma decisões estratégicas de forma independente com base em análises, informações ambíguas e contexto.
  • Negocia acordos complexos em ambientes conflituosos, com diversos perfis de organizações.
  • Apoia a liderança estratégica da Direção de Conservação para o Cerrado.
  • Realiza viagens frequentes, nacionais e/ou internacionais, incluindo noites e fins de semana.
  • Pode trabalhar em condições climáticas variáveis, em locais remotos, terrenos difíceis e perigosos, e sob circunstâncias fisicamente exigentes.

O que você trará à TNC:

  • Diploma de bacharel na área de agronomia, economia, engenharia ambiental e correlata, conservação ambiental, ou combinação equivalente de educação e experiência de pelo menos 7 anos.
  • Experiência em captação de recursos, incluindo identificação de potenciais doadores e desenvolvimento de relacionamento com doadores.
  • Experiência na gestão de projetos complexos ou múltiplos, incluindo administração financeira e coordenação do trabalho de outros profissionais e parceiros, incluindo equipe, manejo de carga de trabalho e organização de demandas.
  • Experiência em supervisão, incluindo motivação, liderança, definição de objetivos e gestão de desempenho.
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento de parcerias com organizações sem fins lucrativos, grupos comunitários e/ou órgãos governamentais.

title: Senior Embedded Products and Software Reliability Engineer
description:
Senior Embedded Products and Software Reliability Engineer

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Embedded Reliability Engineer with a strong background in protection and control systems, energy management devices, and utility‑scale software for transmission and distribution (T&D) applications. In this role, you will lead reliability initiatives across the lifecycle of critical grid automation products, including protection relays, control devices, digital substation solutions, and advanced software platforms. Your work will directly support utility customers in achieving higher uptime, reduced lifecycle costs, and safer grid operation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Perform reliability modeling and statistical analysis of energy management and protection/control products to predict field performance and act as authority for reliability design decisions.
  • Develop and execute reliability test plans for hardware and software, including hardware‑in‑the‑loop (HIL), environmental, and stress testing for grid components.
  • Conduct and lead FMEA, FMECA, and Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for hardware/software failure events across embedded systems and communication layers.
  • Work with product design, systems engineering, and software teams to ensure Design for Reliability (DfR) is embedded from concept through deployment.
  • Analyze field data from deployed devices to identify systemic issues and recommend corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with utilities and customers to support grid asset performance programs and grid modernization initiatives, including IEC 61850, virtualization, and advanced diagnostics.
  • Develop and maintain reliability KPIs (e.g., MTBF, FIT rate, availability) for product lines and integrate into product development and quality programs.
  • Identify and drive adoption of predictive and condition‑based maintenance strategies using remote diagnostics, SCADA, and sensor data.
  • Consult and align with the Innovation Office and Applications team to ensure reliability priorities influence working group participation, standards leadership, and technology strategy.
  • Stay current on regulatory compliance requirements (e.g., NERC, IEEE, IEC standards) impacting utility asset reliability and cybersecurity.
  • Provide coaching, training, and guidance on reliability practices to internal teams and external stakeholders.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Systems Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Minimum of 7 years of experience in reliability, systems, or product engineering in the energy or utility sector.

Desired Characteristics

  • Familiar with protection & control systems, grid‑edge devices, substation automation, and utility‑grade software solutions.
  • Hands‑on experience with reliability engineering tools and standards (e.g., ReliaSoft, ISO 9001/55000, IEC 61025).
  • Familiarity with communications protocols and standards used in T&D systems: IEC 61850, DNP3, Modbus, IEEE C37.118, etc.
  • Strong analytical skills and experience with data analysis platforms (e.g., Python, R, Minitab, Power BI).
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to engage cross‑functional teams and utility customers.
  • Understanding of grid reliability challenges in T&D environments and willingness to travel for customer engagements.
  • Collaborative leadership across engineering, field teams, and customers.
  • Data‑driven problem‑solving mindset with attention to long‑term product health and systems thinking.
  • Proactive approach to emerging technologies and continuous improvement.
  • Master’s degree in Reliability or Systems Engineering.
  • Certified Reliability Engineer (CRE) or similar professional certification.
  • Familiar with model‑based design and HIL testing (e.g., RTDS, PSCAD, EMTP) for utility applications and simulation tools used in electronics and CAD design.
  • Experience working directly with T&D utilities, supporting product deployments, failure investigations, or asset strategies.
  • Familiarity with cybersecurity risk and reliability considerations for critical infrastructure.

Benefits

The base pay range for this position is $152,400.00 – $203,200.00 USD annually, with a 15% variable incentive bonus. This posting closes on October 20, 2025. Healthcare benefits include medical, dental, vision, and prescription drug coverage; a 24/7 nurse‑based resource and Health Coach; the Employee Assistance Program. Retirement benefits include the GE Retirement Savings Plan and a 401(k) savings opportunity with company matching and contributions. Other benefits: tuition assistance, adoption assistance, paid parental leave, disability insurance, life insurance, and paid time‑off.

Relocation Assistance: No. This is a remote position.

title: Desenvolvedor ABAP CPI Sênior
description:
Procuramos um profissional experiente para atuar como Analista/Consultor de Integração, com foco nas tecnologiasSAPABAP eSAPCloud Platform Integration (CPI) . Este papel é fundamental para desenhar, desenvolver e implementar soluções de integração robustas entre os sistemasSAP e plataformas externas, garantindo a fluidez e a integridade dos dados.

Atribuições principais:

  • Desenvolvimento ABAP: Projetar e codificar programas ABAP (relatórios, módulos de função, BAPIs, BAdIs, exits, etc.) para preparar e processar dados, e garantir a comunicação eficiente com oSAPCPI.
  • Integração SAPCPI: Desenvolver e manter iFlows (Integration Flows) complexos noSAPCPI, incluindo o mapeamento de mensagens, a transformação de dados e a implementação de scripts Groovy/Java.
  • Análise e Desenho: Atuar na análise de requisitos de negócio, traduzindo-os em especificações técnicas detalhadas para as integrações.
  • Solução de Problemas: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas de integração, monitorando o fluxo de mensagens e garantindo a estabilidade das soluções.
  • Colaboração: Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com equipes funcionais e de outras áreas para garantir que as integrações atendam às necessidades do negócio.

Requisitos:

  • Experiência comprovada em desenvolvimentoSAPABAP .
  • Conhecimento profundo emSAPCPI (Cloud Platform Integration), incluindo a criação de iFlows e a configuração de adaptadores (SFTP, SOAP, HTTP, OData, etc.).
  • Experiência com APIs e serviços web (SOAP, REST).
  • Habilidade para analisar e resolver problemas de forma eficaz, com atenção aos detalhes.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe.

Diferenciais:

  • Certificação SAPem ABAP ou CPI.
  • Conhecimento de outras plataformas de integração, como SAPPI/PO.
  • Experiência com o SAPS/4HANA.

Localidade da posição: 100% remoto!

This role is perfect for someone who loves clarity, thrives on process, and can bring harmony to a fast-moving cross-functional environment. You’ll be the person who ensures our product teams are aligned, our documentation is standardized, and nothing slips through the cracks.

  • Work closely with Design, Engineering, and GTM to make sure everyone understands priorities, status, and the “why” behind decisions.

We would love to meet you if you have:

  • 8+ years in product or program management, with at least 2 years leading teams.
  • Previous experience working in a SaaS company, ideally in a product operations or product management function.
  • Deep experience building scalable processes for product planning, documentation, and release management.
  • A knack for simplifying complexity and creating structure without bureaucracy.
  • Strong communication skills — able to align executives and empower ICs alike.
  • Familiarity with tools like Productboard, Jira, and Confluence, and the judgment to know when a process helps (and when it hinders).

Success Looks Like:

  • Every product initiative has a clear owner, definition of success, and consistent documentation.
  • The team knows what’s next, what’s blocked, and where to find information — always.
  • Leadership can trust that roadmaps, PRDs, and metrics are complete, standardized, and up to date.

description:
Join to apply for the Lead ML Engineer, Recommendation Systems role at Launch Potato .

WHO ARE WE?

Launch Potato is a profitable digital media company that reaches over 30M+ monthly visitors through brands such as FinanceBuzz, All About Cookies, and OnlyInYourState. As The Discovery and Conversion Company, our mission is to connect consumers with the world’s leading brands through data-driven content and technology. Headquartered in South Florida with a remote‑first team spanning over 15 countries, we’ve built a high-growth, high-performance culture where speed, ownership, and measurable impact drive success.

WHY JOIN US?

At Launch Potato, you’ll accelerate your career by owning outcomes, moving fast, and driving impact with a global team of high-performers. We convert audience attention into action through data, machine learning, and continuous optimization. We’re hiring a Machine Learning Engineer (Recommendation Systems) to build the personalization engine behind our portfolio of brands. You’ll design, deploy, and scale ML systems that power real‑time recommendations across millions of user journeys. This role gives you the chance to work on systems serving 100M+ predictions daily, directly impacting engagement, retention, and revenue at scale.

MUST HAVE

  • 7+ years building and scaling production ML systems with measurable business impact
  • Experience deploying ML systems serving 100M+ predictions daily
  • Strong background in ranking algorithms (collaborative filtering, learning-to-rank, deep learning)
  • Proficiency with Python and ML frameworks (TensorFlow or PyTorch)
  • Skilled with SQL and modern data warehouses (Snowflake, BigQuery, Redshift) plus data lakes
  • Familiarity with distributed computing (Spark, Ray) and LLM/AI Agent frameworks
  • Track record of improving business KPIs via ML-powered personalization
  • Experience with A/B testing platforms and experiment logging best practices

YOUR ROLE

Your mission: Drive business growth by building and optimizing the recommendation systems that personalize experience for millions of users daily. You’ll own the modeling, feature engineering, data pipelines, and experimentation that make personalization smarter, faster, and more impactful.

OUTCOMES

  • Build and deploy ML models serving 100M+ predictions per day to personalize user experiences at scale
  • Enhance data processing pipelines (Spark, Beam, Dask) with efficiency and reliability improvements
  • Design ranking algorithms that balance relevance, diversity, and revenue
  • Deliver real-time personalization with latency <50 ms across key product surfaces
  • Run statistically rigorous A/B tests to measure true business impact
  • Optimize for latency, throughput, and cost efficiency in production
  • Partner with product, engineering, and analytics to launch high-impact personalization features
  • Implement monitoring systems and maintain clear ownership for model reliability

COMPETENCIES

  • Technical Mastery: You know ML architecture, deployment, and tradeoffs inside out
  • Experimentation Infrastructure: You set up systems for rapid testing and retraining (MLflow, W&B)
  • Impact-Driven: You design models that move revenue, retention, or engagement
  • Collaborative: You thrive working with engineers, PMs, and analysts to scope features
  • Analytical Thinking: You break down data trends and design rigorous test methodologies

title: Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer
description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft.

Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you! We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond‑level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up‑to‑date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation‑only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large‑scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well‑tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience in an object‑oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Descrição da vaga: Venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no país! ✈️ A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, garantindo que todos os voos recebam o melhor atendimento com o máximo de agilidade; nossas equipes são reconhecidas pela dedicação, profissionalismo, ética, qualidade e expertise apresentados; somos 100% dedicados ao cumprimento de nossas funções.

Globalmente, a dnata foi fundada em 1959 em Dubai, possui mais de 46.000 funcionários divididos em 38 países nos 6 continentes, com atuação em 136 aeroportos e auxiliando mais de 347 clientes. Esta é uma vaga exclusiva para o Aeroporto de Salvador (SSA).

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • MECÂNICO : Responsável por atuar na manutenção preventiva/corretiva de equipamentos da linha pesada, com foco em motores a diesel e equipamentos pesados.
  • ELETRICISTA : Responsável pelo reparo e manutenções preventivas em sistemas e componentes elétricos, eletrônicos voltado para área automotiva aeroportuário, exemplo: linha Diesel.
  • SERRALHEIRO : Responsável por reparos estruturais com serviços de solda e serralheria em equipamentos de atendimento aeroportuário.
  • PINTOR : Responsável pela preparação, pinturas e reparos em equipamentos de atendimento aeroportuário.
  • AUXILIAR DE MANUTENÇÃO : Auxilia na manutenção em serviços de reparos mecânicos, elétricos, hidráulicos e borracharia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino médio completo; formação técnica na área relacionada;
  • Conhecimento sólido em sistemas mecânicos, hidráulicos e elétricos de veículos pesados;
  • Habilidade para diagnosticar problemas e desenvolver soluções eficazes;
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar manuais técnicos, esquemas e diagramas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Compromisso com a qualidade, segurança e eficiência no trabalho;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos e horas extras conforme necessário;
  • Experiência anterior com manutenção de equipamentos de apoio em solo aeroportuário;
  • Familiaridade com as normas de segurança e regulamentos operacionais de aeroportos.

Para estas posições, nos aspectos físicos exigem-se coordenação motora ampla e fina, destreza, articulação dos membros superiores e inferiores, postura em bipedestação para desenvolvimento de suas atividades, rotação e flexão do tronco, esforço físico, locomoção e deambulação para realização de manutenções e atendimento de serviços emergenciais.

Nos aspectos sensoriais exigem-se acuidade visual para inspeções, manutenções e condução de veículo a serviço da empresa (atividade regulamentada pelo CTB – código de trânsito brasileiro) e percepção auditiva para atendimento telefônico, identificação de ruídos de anormalidades em peças e equipamentos e identificação de sinais sonoros emergenciais em vias públicas e em áreas operacionais.

Nos aspectos neuropsíquicos exigem-se atenção, concentração, habilidade organizacional, criatividade, interpretação de desenhos técnicos, dados e iniciativa para solução de situações causais.

Informações adicionais

Estamos sempre em busca de novos talentos, então faça o seu cadastro e venha fazer parte do time dnata Brasil! Lider mundial em fornecer serviços aéreos! Junte-se a nós e venha trabalhar em uma das maiores empresas especializadas em assistência à aviação no Brasil. A dnata Brasil opera em 30 aeroportos, atendendo as principais companhias aéreas nacionais e internacionais que operam no país, sempre 100% dedicados em cumprir nossas funções com ética, qualidade, expertise e excelência.

Ready to roll up your sleeves and help transform local marketing forever? At Olly Olly, we’re blending technology and real-world expertise to empower businesses across the U.S. like never before.

title: | Enterprise Architect | Specialist
description:
(Enterprise Architect | Specialist)

Remoto | 44h semanais

Para você nos conhecer melhor

Desenvolvemos pessoas, softwares & negócios

+15 anos de experiência desenvolvendo software em 4 continentes com NPS +84, nos colocando em zona de excelência!

Atuamos no desenvolvimento de soluções digitais (web, mobile, BI, RPA, entre outros), com sedes em São Paulo, Porto Alegre, Belo Horizonte e EUA.

Overview da oportunidade

Estamos em busca de uma Pessoa Arquiteta Corporativa Especialista que será responsável por liderar e apoiar atividades estratégicas e holísticas relacionadas à definição, desenvolvimento e gestão de padrões de modelagem e arquitetura corporativa.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Atuar como líder na implementação e manutenção de uma arquitetura corporativa integrada, alinhando-a com os objetivos estratégicos da organização;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com as equipes de Negócios e Técnicas, promovendo sinergia e garantindo que os requisitos técnicos sejam compreendidos e incorporados nas soluções;
  • Apoiar o time de Negócios no desenvolvimento de uma visão técnica mais robusta, facilitando a comunicação entre áreas e orientando na criação de representações técnicas como o modelo C4;
  • Estabelecer e gerenciar padrões de modelagem para assegurar consistência e eficiência no desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas;
  • Identificar oportunidades para otimizar processos e soluções existentes, orientando a organização rumo à inovação e à sustentabilidade tecnológica;
  • Esta posição exige habilidades técnicas, visão estratégica e competência para colaborar com equipes diversas, com foco na criação de valor sustentável e escalável para a organização;
  • Estruturar e manter os direcionadores estratégicos da Arquitetura Corporativa, como Princípios, Metas e Objetivos estratégicos, além de Capacidades por produto;
  • Definir e estruturar padrões de estudos para análise e desenvolvimento de soluções corporativas;
  • Atuar como guardião da aplicação dos padrões nos estudos, garantindo excelência e consistência nas entregas da equipe;
  • Zelar pela padronização dos roadmaps por superintendência, assegurando alinhamento estratégico e operacional;
  • Criar e manter roadmaps estratégicos que detalhem a evolução do portfólio de soluções corporativas, definindo transições do estado atual para o estado futuro desejado, em conformidade com a arquitetura de soluções;
  • Desenvolver entregáveis, como padrões de estudos para análises estruturadas, roadmap evolutivo para suprir gaps entre o estado atual e o futuro desejável, mapa de capacidades com análise de calor e insights para novos estudos com base em deficiências ou necessidades de evolução nas capacidades existentes;
  • Revisão e proposição do Comitê e Fóruns de Negócios estratégicos;

Habilidades que você precisa ter

  • Faculdade em área de TI (Ciências da Computação, Processamento de Dados, Análise de sistemas, Inteligência Artificial, Business Analytics, Transformação Digital, outros relacionados);
  • Especialização ou Pós Graduação em áreas relacionadas à TI;
  • Experiência em Arquitetura Corporativa;
  • Experiência com modelagem de Arquitetura em soluções como Archimate, LeanIX, Hopex ou Similar;
  • Bom entendimento de gerenciamento de produtos, princípios ágeis e metodologias de desenvolvimento e capacidade de apoiar equipes ágeis, fornecendo aconselhamento e orientação sobre oportunidades, impacto e riscos, levando em consideração dívidas técnicas e arquitetônicas;
  • Excelentes habilidades analíticas, de planejamento, organizacionais e técnicas;
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar com desenvolvedores em um ambiente terceirizado;
  • Experiente em termos organizacionais, com capacidade de navegar pelas políticas organizacionais;
  • Habilidade de influenciar, orientar e facilitar as partes interessadas e pares na tomada de decisões;
  • Capacidade de articular novas ideias e conceitos para públicos técnicos e não técnicos;
  • Capacidade de compreender as perspectivas de longo prazo e de curto prazo das situações;
  • Capacidade de traduzir capacidades e requisitos de negócios de estado futuro em requisitos de arquitetura de solução;
  • Capacidade de propor e estimar o impacto financeiro de alternativas de arquitetura de solução;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma criativa e analítica para resolver problemas de negócios e propor soluções;
  • Capacidade de compreender rapidamente as funções e capacidades de novas tecnologias;
  • Confiável e respeitado como um líder de pensamento que pode influenciar e persuadir líderes de negócios e de TI e equipes de desenvolvimento de TI;
  • Permanecer imparcial em relação a qualquer tecnologia específica ou escolha de fornecedor e estar mais interessado em resultados do que em preferências pessoais;
  • Mostrar curiosidade intelectual e integridade;
  • Motivado e impulsionado pela obtenção de resultados de negócios de longo prazo;
  • Capacidade de trabalhar de forma eficaz em um ambiente de equipe e liderar equipes multifuncionais.

Habilidades que vão fazer você se destacar

  • Experiência com SAP LeanIX;
  • Certificações em Scrum, PMP e/ou TOGAF.

O que você vai encontrar na GX2

  • Hub de conteúdo autoral segmentado por trilhas de conhecimento (IA, QA, Agilidade, Design UX/UI, Produto, Desenvolvimento de Software);
  • Talks mensais focados no desenvolvimento de soft skills;
  • Cultura de cuidado com as pessoas e saúde mental;
  • Plataforma de saúde mental e bem-estar;
  • Follow Up GX2: Acompanhamento mensal individual voltado ao bem-estar e desenvolvimento.

Recado da GX2

Esta é uma vaga abrangente a todas as pessoas interessadas. Trabalhamos diariamente para construir um ambiente diverso e plural, que valoriza e respeita as diferenças e defendemos a liberdade de ser quem se é, livre de estereótipos e preconceitos.

description:
Founder’s Right Hand – Remote

Join to apply for the Founder’s Right Hand – Remote role at The Flex

About The Flex

At The Flex, we’re reinventing how the world rents. Renting a home should be as effortless as ordering on Amazon — instant, borderless, and intelligent. Our proprietary Property Management System powers this revolution—automating operations, optimizing pricing, and creating seamless experiences for guests and landlords alike. We’re assembling a small, elite team of builders—ambitious problem‑solvers who thrive in fast‑paced environments and take extreme ownership of results. If you want to build a global company alongside a visionary founder, this role is your gateway.

THE ROLE

As the Founder’s Right Hand, you’ll work directly with the CEO across every aspect of the business—strategy, operations, growth, partnerships, and product. You’ll be the founder’s execution partner, turning ideas into results and ensuring the company runs with speed, precision, and focus. This is a high‑trust, high‑impact position designed for someone who wants to learn how to build a global company from the inside and eventually lead one.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Execution – Translate ideas into actionable plans and ensure flawless delivery across product, operations, and growth.
  • Project Ownership – Lead cross‑functional initiatives—from new city launches to process automation—and drive them to completion.
  • Operational Support – Handle critical business priorities, streamline workflows, and eliminate bottlenecks.
  • Research & Analysis – Conduct deep dives into markets, competitors, and new opportunities to support decision‑making.
  • Talent & Recruiting – Help identify and onboard exceptional talent that fits The Flex’s high‑performance culture.
  • Founder Leverage – Act as an extension of the CEO—anticipating needs, managing priorities, and keeping the organization aligned.
  • Growth & Partnerships – Support business development efforts and nurture relationships with partners, investors, and key stakeholders.

What You Bring

  • 2–5 years of experience in startups, consulting, operations, or venture building.
  • A strong mix of strategic thinking and hands‑on execution.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to thrive in fast‑changing, high‑pressure environments.
  • Entrepreneurial mindset— you don’t wait for direction; you make things happen.
  • Curiosity for real estate tech, automation, and scaling businesses.

Why Join The Flex

  • Work directly with the founder. Learn how to build, scale, and operate a global business.
  • Accelerate your career. This is a launchpad to senior leadership or your own venture.
  • High‑impact role. You’ll directly shape company direction and execution.
  • Remote‑first. Work from anywhere with autonomy and ownership.
  • Competitive compensation + performance‑based incentives.
  • Elite culture. Join a team obsessed with speed, precision, and excellence.

Do Not Apply If

  • You want a predictable, structured 9–5 job.
  • You prefer comfort over challenge.
  • You avoid accountability or ambiguity.
  • You’re not striving to be among the top 1% in your craft.

The Flex isn’t just a property company — it’s a global ecosystem for flexible living, powered by technology, automation, and ambition. If you want to work side‑by‑side with a founder building at speed and scale, and learn how to build a global business from zero to one—apply now.
